product.title: MEDICUBE PDRN Pink Collagen Toning Gel Toner Pad 70 Sheets
product.body_html:
MEDICUBE PDRN Pink Collagen Toning Gel Toner Pad 70 Sheets

Description

  • With an ultra-slim 0.5mm texture, this product fits snugly onto blemishes, offering spot-targeted brightening. Even with just one use, it provides clinically proven tone correction, keeping your skin clear and radiant every day. The product is medicube’s first-ever ultra-adhesive gel toner pad, developed with a special technique that infuses gel into the fabric, providing a thin yet powerful moisture-retaining formula. It contains premium salmon PDRN, which undergoes an advanced purification process to minimize residues, enhancing its absorption efficiency. With 99% high-purity salmon PDRN, free from unnecessary residues, the formula penetrates faster and deeper, delivering its potent active ingredients effectively to the skin.

How to use

  • 1. After washing your face, gently wipe your entire face in the direction of your skin texture, excluding the area around your eyes and mouth, in the first step of your basic care.
  • 2. Apply it like a pack to areas that require intensive care for a soothing and moisturizing effect.
  • 3. After use, gently pat any remaining toner to help it absorb.
  • *Keep the lid closed and sealed to prevent the pad from drying out.
